ev.q: CDC analyzed data from the 2023 National Immunization Survey-Teen for 16,568 adolescents aged 13–17 years
Estimated vaccination coverage with selected vaccines and doses among adolescents aged 13–17* years, by age at time of interview
the percentage of VFC-eligible adolescents who were up to date with HPV vaccination (HPV UTD) was 10.3 percentage points lower

methods_quotes.q: Cross-sectional analysis was used to estimate vaccination coverage among adolescents aged 13–17 years in the 2023 survey year compared with the 2022 survey year.
Kaplan-Meier techniques were used to account for censoring of vaccination status at age ≥13 years.
the 2007–2010 birth years were compared by age using the 2007 birth year as the reference group
Z-tests were used to compare differences in vaccination coverage by survey year, birth year, and eligibility for the VFC program;
analyses were conducted using SAS-callable SUDAAN (version 11; RTI International)
Estimates with 95% CI >20 might not be reliable.
